name: x11docker
summary: Runs graphical apps and whole desktops inside Docker or podman containers without leaking X access
description: x11docker starts a GUI application from a Docker or podman image and gives it its own isolated X server or Wayland compositor, so the container cannot read keystrokes or windows from your real session. Options cover GPU acceleration, sound, webcam, printers, clipboard sharing, shared folders and running a full desktop environment in a window. It is a single shell script with sensible security defaults.
